item.title: US and Ukraine ‘a lot closer’ on peace deal, Trump says after meeting with Zelenskiy
item.description: PALM BEACH, Florida (Reuters) — President Donald Trump said on Sunday that he and Ukrainian leader Volodymyr Zelenskiy were "getting a lot closer, maybe very close" to an agreement to end the war in Ukraine, while acknowledging that the fate of the disputed Donbas region remains a key unresolved issue. item.title: A critical layer of protection from climate change
item.description: (Pacific GIS and Remote Sensing Council) — Beneath the Pacific Ocean, gardens of seagrass play a critical role in trapping and storing carbon at rates of up to 35 times greater than that of tropical rainforests, a frontline protector from climate change. item.title: Judge disqualifies Naraja, entire Superior Court from gasoline price-fixing case
item.description: SUPERIOR Court Associate Judge Teresa Kim-Tenorio has disqualified Presiding Judge Roberto C. Naraja — and the entire CNMI Superior Court bench — from hearing the long-running class-action lawsuit accusing Mobil Oil Mariana Islands, Inc. and Shell Marianas of gasoline price-fixing. item.title: House rejects Senate version of $1M public land income bill
item.description: THE House of Representatives on Monday unanimously rejected the Senate version of House Bill 24-74, which would appropriate $1 million in public land income to the Public School System and the mayor’s offices of Saipan, Tinian, and Rota.
